One of my best friends was one of the hottest girls in our class, and also had a heart of gold.

When Heidi asked her for her notes, she didn't hesitate. The hambeast borrowed her notes and copied them, and when my friend got them back, they were greasy and smelling of stale food, with smears on them that my friend couldn't really identity. My friend sucked it up, handled them with rubber gloves, and rewrote all her notes, and threw the old ones in the trash.

Since she had a heart of gold however, she for some reason didn't say no the day Heidi asked her to go for lunch with her. Hambeast lamented to her that after two years on campus, she still hadn't made any friends.

Spoiler: Hambeast Heidi stank like a dumpster.

Because my friend is someone who can never say no to pitiful people, she also visited Hambeast Heidi's apartment when invited. Fortunately, just once. Unfortunately, it left her traumatized.

Everything, every last available surface was dirty. When Heidi told my friend to sit down, she just squatted down on her heels, careful not to touch anything.

Heidi continued to talk, but my friend couldn't really catch anything, she was looking for an excuse to get out while trying not to breathe in too much of the air. She also wondered if she would have to burn all of her clothes.

Hambeast Heidi asked my friend for tips on how to be hot like her.

My friend, as delicately as possible, tried to suggest that occasionally washing your clothes is really not a bad idea.

Hambeast Heidi thought that this was not necessary. She hoisted up her shirt, folded over the band of her granny underpants, and told my friend that she could easily wear those for a week and still be clean. My friend said that underwear had brown and yellow rings in it.
